messages:
ana (Marketing): Quick sync — we need the final changelog + docs links for tomorrow's announcement. Is engineering good for a 10:00 PT rollout window? :calendar:
sam (Engineering): 10:00 PT works but we need to freeze the changeset by 07:30 PT so QA can sign off.
ana (Marketing): Got it. Can we get the final changelog snippet to paste into the post? Keep it ≤3 bullets.
lee (Docs): Docs PR is green: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842 — includes 'What's new' and migration notes. I'll paste the short bullets in a sec.
sam (Engineering): Changelog draft in repo under releases/2026-03-22.md. Quick paste:
```
- Faster batching across reshapes, ~20% token cost reduction
- New routing policy 'cost-aware' for mixed tiers
- Console: per-route token breakdown in timeline view
```
marta (Product): Perfect. Marketing can shorten bullets. Ana, do you want the raw PR links for the post?
ana (Marketing): Yes — need both docs PR and the release changelog link. Also confirm the rollback plan: if latency >200ms in canary, we abort?
sam (Engineering): Yes. Canary targets 95th <120ms. Rollback trigger: sustained 95th >200ms for 5m or error rate spike >1%. release-bot will tag and alert. :rotating_light:
release-bot: deploy-candidate-174: canary scheduled 2026-03-22 10:00 PT -> monitors: infra, latency, errors
lee (Docs): Bullets for the post:
- Up to 20% cost reduction via smarter batching
- New 'cost-aware' routing for mixed workloads
- Improved per-route analytics in Console
I'll also add a short migration note for Dedicated/private customers.
ana (Marketing): Thanks Lee — I'll craft the Twitter + blog copy. Will ping here when scheduled. Need the final permalinks (docs + changelog) before 09:00 PT.
sam (Engineering): I'll cut the changelog permalink by 08:45 PT and post here. QA run scheduled 07:35 PT.
ana (Marketing): :thumbsup: sounds good. Also flagging support to prep inbound lead routing flow — Marta can you confirm the analytics tag?
marta (Product): I'll drop the UTM + inbound routing doc into the helpdesk folder by 09:15 PT and loop in CS. /cc @oliver (Release Ops) for on-call.
oliver (Release Ops): On call that window. If anything pops, ping #release-war-room and I'll join. Good to have a single owner for rollback decisions.
ana (Marketing): Copy. I'll post the final draft here at 08:50 PT for a quick read. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
